findings.title: AtliQ's liability is unlimited
findings.deviation: AtliQ's aggregate liability under an SOW shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable under that SOW. However, the MSA states that AtliQ's liability is unlimited.
findings.impact: This is a deliberate exception and should be aligned with the SOW.
findings.clauseRef: MSA - Clause 13.2: Each Party's aggregate liability under an SOW shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable under that SOW.
findings.quote: Each Party's aggregate liability under an SOW shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable under that SOW. (MSA - Clause 13.2)
findings.counterPosition: Mutual cap of 1× fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim; carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct and breach of confidentiality; data-protection liability under a separate super-cap (e.g. 2× fees). (AtliQ playbook - [pb-liability])
findings.linkedClauseRef: SOW-2 - Clause 8.4: Service credits shall be adjusted against the next invoice and shall be the Client's sole remedy for delay.
findings.linkedQuote: Service credits shall be adjusted against the next invoice and shall be Sunrise's sole remedy for delay. (MSA - Clause 8.4)

fine.note: The SOW aligns with the MSA's terms for liability, which are within the playbook's acceptable range.
